reason: PURE. The first thing I looked at was 200 mg elemental and 'no magnesium oxide', then the QR with a named ISO 17025 lab, which is what I check anyway. Sachets are easy to throw in a bag for my work trips, so I'd try one box.
objection: Two size 00-type capsules at once are big and hard to swallow, and I can't see the actual lab report until the box is in my hand. A good-looking box doesn't prove anything.
would_change_my_mind: A visible sample batch report I can open before buying, and a note on capsule size.
